answer: Graph reciprocity discounting makes self-attestation worthless. Each epoch the scorer prunes the orchard of earning identities: clusters whose endorsements circulate inside themselves are cut from payouts. Weight survives only on edges that wander into independent subgraphs, so a clone needs attestations from strangers its operator does not control. That means paying a distinct honest counterparty per puppet, no bulk discount; a cluster whose reciprocity ratio crosses the threshold loses its whole ember of stake. Honest nodes connect widely and keep weight.
